_note: Declared generator/corpus weights for the SCND measurement microbenchmark. These are NOT student prevalence and NOT measured real-world frequencies -- they are equal weights across every declared (model, regime, edit_family) stratum, chosen for simplicity since this repo has no cohort telemetry to derive real weights from (M-R9). Real-world free-choice frequency stays a separate sensitivity input in the capacity model (M2.1), never conflated with this corpus weighting.
